entries.title: Computer names show only beside computers with crewmates
entries.body: With more than one computer set up to run work, the main screen named every computer, even one with no crewmates near it. Now a computer is named only when it has crewmates, and crewmates on this computer alone show no names.
entries.noPicture: The change takes names away from the main screen, so a picture of it shows only their absence.
